issuer: Steffan Derek Hooper, Auckland University of Technology
name: Automated Testing and Validation of Computer Graphics Implementations for Cross-Platform Game Development
statement: Open thesis that states, from published sources (Kenwright 2014; Levy and Novak 2010; Manton and Wilson), what console certification such as Sony's Technical Requirements Checklist tests; the TRC itself is under NDA. Index row P01.
